question: Should QQBot enforce the proposed 16 MiB inbound gateway-frame ceiling despite QQ not publishing a maximum frame size?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and proven, but selecting a ceiling determines whether future valid large gateway events are delivered or discarded and reconnected; repository evidence does not establish that policy choice.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB operational limit
options.body: Merge with the documented tradeoff that frames above 16 MiB are rejected before parsing and reconnect normally.

options.title: Require a QQ-supported limit
options.body: Pause until a QQ gateway contract or authoritative operational evidence supplies a compatible ceiling, then update the constant and proof.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Keep the existing `ws` default until the channel owner defines an explicit inbound-size policy and recovery expectation.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB operational limit
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented tradeoff that frames above 16 MiB are rejected before parsing and reconnect normally.
